scientific_reading: QP092B cleans the debit symbol to S_debit and asks whether the emitted debit layer from QP092A clusters by family/operator. It finds a strong exact-contact cluster, multiple sign-pure family clusters, and multiple sign-pure operator-class clusters. Mixed meson/lepton/operator groups remain open rather than being forced into a single sign law. Family and operator means fail as exact predictive laws, so this is a real cluster grammar discovery, not full debit closure.
next_frontier: derive S_debit sub-operators inside mixed-open clusters, starting with charged leptons, mesons, and octet/heavy branches
